lines: Lilim
Kyaaah~
Minasaki
We're sowwy~
After a light beating, the two of them quickly yielded, and the Devildomian Wasps calmed down as well.
Me
You two never learn, do you? Stop messing with me already.
Lilim & Minasaki
Oookaaay...
The two critters surrendered amicably. I had doubts that they really understood though.
Me
...By the way, you two, did you see a woman with long hair and mechanical legs somewhere?
They had come from the direction of the forest, so there was a chance that they had met Saika. The two of them looked at each other.
Minasaki
The lady with the hat maybe?
Lilim
But she didn't have long hair.
Minasaki
Then maybe the lady with the beauty mark?
Me
That's her! Where is she? You can tell with your power, right, Minasaki?
Minasaki
Oopsie... All of a sudden I'm sleepy...
Lilim
Yeah... my memory is suddenly so...
Me
Really, you two... Alright, alright! Here!
I rummaged through my pockets and handed the critters my meager allowance.
Minasaki
Hm, let's see... she's kinda that way.
Lilim
Thank you! See you again, Chief!
Me
I told you to stop calling me Chief!!!
The sun was already setting. I was walking briskly in the direction Minasaki had pointed.
I wasn't sure if I could trust those two, but actually I had also had a feeling that Saika was in that direction.
Me
(If I remember correctly, there's a mansion over there that my father used as a vacation home. It would be an ideal place for Saika to hide.)
